balance_differs_from_training: Intentionally equal domains; 80/10/10 language quota. Not the earlier training domain mixture.

hosted.budget: Conservative reservation persisted before every attempt. Unknown transport outcomes retain worst-case reservation; completed usage includes reasoning and cached tokens.
hosted.deprecated_snapshot: Official catalog marks snapshot deprecated; availability must be confirmed. No automatic substitution.
hosted.reasoning: minimal, previously verified for this exact snapshot; current access/settings checked before scoring

local.PEFT_parameter_precision: Default FP32 LoRA parameters preserved, same verified PEFT loader for both adapters
local.unscored_warmups: One per actual GPU model-loading session; recorded separately; none count in quality metrics.

v7.selection: Frozen experimental final-step 65 pilot; no post-final checkpoint selection

policy.application: Pinned fpy reducer; reject contract/evidence failures as a whole; preserve prior slots on rejection and append actual user history.
policy.candidate_wire: String containing JSON text; historical ordinary-string acceptance retained. Exactly one decoding pass; explicitly encoded literal-looking strings remain strings.
policy.evidence: Exact nonblank current-message substring, case and whitespace sensitive.
policy.invalid_calls: Readable emitted tuples count as FP, every gold tuple as FN, zero TP on rejected calls; no silent repair, defaults, gold-conditioned postprocessing or semantic retries.

primary_endpoint: Exact non-intent slot/value/status micro F1 in rollout

primary_hypothesis.decision: Prespecified paired percentile 95% interval; no post-hoc equivalence/noninferiority claim.
primary_hypothesis.null: The cohort-specific exact rollout F1 difference v7 minus OpenAI is zero.

research_task: Forecasting-requirement extraction into a tabular time-series 79-slot schema, not actual forecasting accuracy.
schedule_limitation: Local order alternates within 20-conversation family blocks; hosted requests follow the paired GPU block. Hardware, transport, reasoning and output constraints differ.
stopping_rule: One reviewed frozen cohort, one planned matched experiment, independent raw verification and documented failure analysis. No additional training or outcome-driven cohort expansion.
subgroup_analysis: Domain/language/template-family secondary exploratory; no universal conclusions or multiplicity-adjusted claims.
synthetic_authorship: Agent-authored parameterized synthetic candidate; independent human review required. Not independent human-authored requests.
template_clustering: Twelve authored macro-template groups, with related variants/translations across domains. Shared generic clauses across groups remain a limitation.

tracks.component: Exact same gold-replayed prior state, schema and logical instructions for all arms.
tracks.rollout: Fixed reviewed user scripts; each model uses its own accepted accumulated state.
